entries.title: Job 40:2
segments: Complaining of the ways of God is finding fault with him, as if we were wiser than he, and could instruct him as to the best way of governing the world; and all must one day answer to him for all the hard speeches which they have uttered against him.

entries.title: Job 40:4
segments:
Lay my hand upon my mouth; be silent. 
 
Right views of God will silence objections to his providence,a nd lead us humbly to submit to all his dispensations; saying, It is the Lord; let him do as seemeth good in his sight.

entries.title: Job 40:9
segments: The character, works, and ways of God, show that he alone is fitted to govern the world; and that all creatures are, and for ever must be, at his disposal.

entries.title: Job 40:13
segments: Bind their faces in secret; thrust them bound into dungeons, where they shall no more be seen nor heard of.

entries.title: Job 40:15
segments:
Behemoth; supposed by some to be the elephant; by others, the hippopotamus. 
 
The greatest and most formidable of creatures on the land or in the water, are dependent on God; and he can control them with as much ease as he does the smallest and weakest, and dispose of them at his pleasure.

entries.title: Job 40:19
segments: The chief; one of the most wonderful beasts that God has made.

entries.title: Job 40:24
segments: He taketh it with his eyes; or, Can one take him in his sight, or pierce his nose with a hook or ring?
